info.title: Mercenta API — Testnet
info.description: Source-derived public API reference. Testnet is a rehearsal with test assets and simulated digital delivery. Catalogue supplier prices in USD are not USDC payment quotes. Generic response objects are explicitly untyped until a stable response schema exists. Never submit passwords, seed phrases or provider keys.
